## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit, property, integration or end-to-end as appropriate).
- [ ] QC tests, physics and norms cite their source and have a worked-example test.
- [ ] Docs updated (reference, how-to or README) where users are affected.
- [ ] Schemas and data contracts updated first; breaking changes are versioned.
- [ ] No secrets, no personal data, no data files committed; budgets respected; sources attributed.
- [ ] No machine learning or model APIs added (ADR-0002).
- [ ] An ADR is added or superseded if this changes a recorded decision or adds a technology.
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` ticked if this completes an item.
